tie_break: validation mean AUC ascending, then proposal index ascending; seed index -1
arm_order: A1 then A2 for even outer-seed index; A2 then A1 for odd
task_seed_rule: first 8 bytes SHA256(canonical compact sorted JSON of ["EXP-15",domain,...components]), masked to 31 bits
local_seed_rule: stable_seed("local",phase,outer_seed,task semantic fingerprint), shared across arms and candidates
interpretation: 95% paired percentile interval wholly below zero: positive signal; wholly above zero: negative signal; all deltas exactly zero: no detectable difference; otherwise inconclusive
pilot_adjustable: inner budget or structural benchmark parameters only for measured infeasibility/saturation
symmetric provider settings if engineering requires

freeze.amendment: No pilot-informed scientific setting changes; tested provenance and lossless packaging added.

deployment_fallback: Permanently switch failed selected program to exact seed; preserve actual history/local seed and remaining budget.
representative: Lowest validation AUC among selected A2 policies; ties by outer-seed order; freeze before all holdout.
source_packaging: Exact evaluated source in immutable JSON; records above 450000 UTF-8 bytes use deterministic gzip mtime=0, lossless.
